name: LYGO LLM Local Console
publish_rule: Agents build, verify and report. The steward publishes. No push to GitHub/HuggingFace/ClawHub/social, no deployment, no live Star Chart write by an agent.

public_gateway.mode: chat-only, P0 both ways, rate limited

usb_stick.role: the same kit, self-contained on the builder stick (LYGO CLAW)

embed.state: not booted by the stick launcher

usb_stick.state: save/ under the stick kit; every write through src/atomicio.py, every state read through atomicio.read_text()

tests.discovery: python -m unittest discover -s tests (from the kit root)

tests.previous_line: Ran 102 tests in 13.031s (before the D13 fix)

local.model: qwen2.5-coder:7b (default preference; smaller hosts fall back by tool_rank + RAM)
local.default_policy: registry.PREFER_IDS + registry.tool_rank(): the best TOOL-calling model the host can hold, size only as a tier tiebreak

api.policy: DeepSeek is the always-default provider and leads the failover order (cloud_api.DEFAULT_PROVIDER); health publishes default_provider + is_default

handoff.result: same turn re-run locally + warning banner + receipt

cloud.answer: deepseek-chat via the DeepSeek API - engine https://api.deepseek.com, with llama.cpp (:11441, qwen2.5:3b) booted as local standby.

input_contract.rejects: 400 {"error":"no_input"} when there is no user text and no image
input_contract.rule: never answer a request you did not understand (defect D13)

closed_defects: D13 - /api/chat answered a payload it did not understand; fixed 2026-09-17 and verified against the live console
D15 - fixed .json.tmp name in four persistence modules killed the stick console mid-chat (WinError 32); src/atomicio.py added
D16 - reader-vs-writer WinError 5 on the same index under load; per-path lock + no-op rewrite skip + bounded retry + in-place fallback
D17 - readers denied Errno 13 for the instant of a swap; atomicio.read_text() now retries transient denials on every state read
D18 - stick port contract 9651/11451/11452; foreign 8080 and 11434 never claimed, enforced by tests/test_usb_portability.py
D19 - the stick MODEL_MANIFEST.json contradicted itself (llama3.1:8b vs qwen2.5:3b); data-fixed with backup

docs.index_tool: tools/make_index.py - AST module/function index = whitepaper Appendix B

prompt_budget.rule: the system prompt is never trimmed; trim_history() drops old turns first

invariants: local is the default brain and is complete on its own; the API is additive and must degrade to local
one source of truth per fact: the effective brain is threaded into compose_system(), never re-derived from saved state
the host never authors the answer: facts are injected, limbs pre-run, placeholders repaired in place
runtime facts (build, model, engine, brain, standby) are always present in the prompt
the public gateway has no limbs, no disks, no admin map, no steward data; P0 gates input and output
credentials are never printed, never transported to the USB, never embedded in documents or prompts, always [REDACTED]
every turn returns a receipt id; a claimed action without a receipt is not a result

data_safety.policy: never copied to the USB, never committed, never echoed; paths only

known_gaps: hosted portal mode is NOT live: web_portal/portal.json hosted_base is empty
image-only turns are accepted but the default local engine qwen2.5:3b has no vision
studio UI (portal/) and public UI (web_portal/) are duplicated trees
engine ctx 8192 tokens limits long documents
public gateway has no per-day quota or IP ban list
engine ctx is 8192 tokens (the coder model itself offers 32768) - raising it needs a KV-memory plan per host
the 747 MB GPU backend store on the stick is not part of the public SKU; exclusion policy still to confirm
verified on one host (RTX 4060 Ti): the CPU-only path is covered by tests and the CPU bench, not by a second machine
ternary/low-bit families that need a forked llama.cpp (e.g. PrismML Ternary Bonsai) will not load on the shipped stock engine - by design
roadmap: 1 make hosted portal real (gateway + HTTPS + hosted_base)
2 harden the public path (per-day quota, IP block, quota counter)
3 finish cloud verification: 402 stub handoff re-run
4 ship the model chooser (studio + public whitelist)
5 de-duplicate the two UIs into one shared chat/brain component
6 DONE 2026-09-17: /api/chat rejects a payload with no user text (400 no_input) and honours messages[]/prompt/message
7 sync the kit to the USB in the steward's chosen direction
8 long-context pass (raise -c, re-budget, re-run the budget test)
9 host/engine cleanup (stale U: roots, duplicate env key, socket warning)
10 self-check that lists credential-bearing files and refuses to export them

performance.backend_store: engine/backends/<name>/ (overlay DLLs or a complete engine build)
performance.verdict_store: data/perf.json (keyed per host and per backend file hash)
performance.vulkan_on_this_host: crashes inside nvoglv64.dll at any ngl (0xC0000005) -> self-test gate, defect D16
performance.flash_attn: opt-in via config/console.json; measured slower on this CUDA path (2620 vs 3246 tok/s prompt)

flag_bench_2026_09_18.no_mmap_flag: invalid in this build -> -lm/--load-mode; mmap=False now maps to '-lm none'

performance.unloadable_model_survival: data/model_verdicts.json keeps per-host verdicts keyed to the file; a brain that cannot load is swapped for the next candidate instead of killing the boot
